assumptions.choice: fixed stake of 10 shares via a 'stake' parameter passed as size= on buy/sell
assumptions.reason: spec explicitly requires fixed-stake sizing but gives no value; 10 shares is a reasonable fixed quantity relative to $10,000 starting cash on AAPL

assumptions.choice: manual stop check each bar in next() comparing bar Low/High to the live Kijun value, rather than a bracket/StopTrail order
assumptions.reason: the stop must be recalculated every bar to the latest Kijun value; backtrader bracket orders and StopTrail only support a fixed price or fixed trailing offset set at submission time, so a per-bar dynamically-updated stop level requires manual condition checking to be implemented literally as specified

assumptions.choice: use bar Low for the long stop check (low <= kijun) and bar High for the short stop check (high >= kijun)
assumptions.reason: spec says price 'hits' the stop; Low/High are the OHLC fields that represent intrabar touches, whereas Close would miss intrabar stop hits
